Specification: This module is a small test specification for recursion and module instantiation. It declares a recursive operator g, instantiates another module test203a with substitutions A <- g and b <- n inside the definition of foo, and defines g(n) recursively using an IF expression and the instantiated operator h accessed from foo(n-1)!h. The file does not define a transition system, state variables, or temporal behavior; instead it uses a single ASSUME block to assert expected values of the recursive computation and to print a confirmation message.
IfThenElse: IF n = 0 THEN 1 ELSE n * foo(n-1)!h
